related_selection_script:
import subprocess,pathlib,json,os
root='/tmp/4184-tests';env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_TARGET_DIR='/home/runner/grit/target',CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2',CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG='0',CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG='0',CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0')
phase=os.environ.get('PHASE','before')
# The unmodified full gate is recorded separately; this runs the same compilable targets
# on both trees without editing or hiding the upstream compilation failure.
meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['cargo','metadata','--no-deps','--format-version','1'],cwd=root,env=env))
tests=[]
for pkg in meta['packages']:
 if pkg['name']!='grit-lib':continue
 for t in pkg['targets']:
  name=t['name']
  if t['kind']==['test'] and (name.startswith(('refs_','refstore_','branch_','worktree_','repository_')) or name in ['config_includeif_onbranch','config_cascade_session','reftable_worktree_git_compat']):tests += ['--test',name]
commands=[('cli',['cargo','test','-p','grit-cli','--no-fail-fast']),('related',['cargo','test','-p','grit-lib','--no-fail-fast',*tests])]
result={}
for name,args in commands:
 with open('/tmp/4184-'+name+'-'+phase+'.log','w') as log:r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 result[name]=r.returncode;print(name,r.returncode,flush=True)
pathlib.Path('/tmp/4184-supplemental-'+phase+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
